item.eeeabsmobs.remove_mob.tip_1.zh: 左键移除EEEAB的生物模组的生物或实体

item.eeeabsmobs.remove_mob.tip_2.en: Right-click to remove 'EEEAB's Mobs' mobs/entities in a 16x16x16 area
item.eeeabsmobs.remove_mob.tip_2.zh: 右键移除自身范围16×16×16的EEEAB模组生物或实体

item.eeeabsmobs.animation_controller.tip.en: Left-click to select the animation entity and right-click to play the animation of the selected entity
item.eeeabsmobs.animation_controller.tip.zh: 左键选中动画实体，右键播放选中实体的动画

item.eeeabsmobs.guardian_core.tip_1.en:
Hold the right-click to release a laser, dealing 5 base damage plus 1% of the target's maximum health. 
It continuously consumes the item's durability while in use, and when not in use, the durability automatically recovers while in the inventory
item.eeeabsmobs.guardian_core.tip_1.zh:
按住右键释放激光，造成5点基础伤害+目标最大生命值的1%伤害。
使用期间持续消耗物品耐久值，未使用时在背包中自动恢复耐久

item.eeeabsmobs.buster_gauntlet.tip.en: Right-click to fire a grenade, dealing up to %1$s explosive damage
item.eeeabsmobs.buster_gauntlet.tip.zh: 右键发射榴弹造成最大%1$s爆炸伤害

item.eeeabsmobs.chainsword.tip.en: When there is no attack cooldown, dealing damage to the same type of target stacks 1 layer of Rend, increasing damage by %1$s per stack, up to %2$s stacks. Decays by 1 stack per second; switching targets resets the stack count
item.eeeabsmobs.chainsword.tip.zh: 在无攻击冷却时对同种目标生物造成伤害可叠加1层撕裂效果，每层使伤害%1$s，最多%2$s层。每秒衰减1层，攻击其他目标则重置层数

item.eeeabsmobs.doombolt_battleaxe.tip.en: Hold right-click to throw. Upon impact, it releases an area-of-effect surge and automatically returns. While crouching, right-click the ground to release multiple electric surges in a fan-shaped area ahead
item.eeeabsmobs.doombolt_battleaxe.tip.zh: 长按右键投掷，命中后释放范围电涌，并自动飞回。下蹲时对地面右键，向前方扇形区域释放多道电涌

item.eeeabsmobs.soul_summon_necklace.tip.en: Take damage accumulates to %1$s summon Corpse. Can counteract the side effects brought on by the Frenzy effect
item.eeeabsmobs.soul_summon_necklace.tip.zh: 承受伤害累计达到%1$s召唤死尸。可抵消狂乱效果带来的副作用

item.eeeabsmobs.immortal_sword.tip.en: Gives the attacker the erosion status
item.eeeabsmobs.immortal_sword.tip.zh: 赋予被攻击者侵蚀状态

item.eeeabsmobs.immortal_staff.tip.en: Right-click to launch a shaman bomb, with a 25% base chance to fire a special projectile (this base probability is affected by luck or bad luck)
item.eeeabsmobs.immortal_staff.tip.zh: 右键发射巫师炸弹，有25%基准发射特殊弹丸（基础概率受幸运或霉运影响）

item.eeeabsmobs.guardian_axe.tip_2.en: Right-click on the ground to release a skill that deals magic damage equal to the user's weapon damage (ignoring armor, with the damage decreasing over distance)
item.eeeabsmobs.guardian_axe.tip_2.zh: 朝地面右键释放技能，造成等同于使用者持有武器的魔法伤害（无视护甲，造成的伤害随距离衰减）

item.structure.eeeabsmobs.eye_of_bloody_.en: Right-click to find the Bloody Altar structure
item.structure.eeeabsmobs.eye_of_bloody_.zh: 右键查找血色祭坛结构

item.structure.eeeabsmobs.eye_of_corefor.en: Right-click to find the Coreforge Ruins structure
item.structure.eeeabsmobs.eye_of_corefor.zh: 右键查找机核哨站结构

block.eeeabsmobs.sliding_door_level1.tip.en: This door requires a Chain Gear Core or Annihilator Sawblade to open
block.eeeabsmobs.sliding_door_level1.tip.zh: 这扇门需要「链齿核心」或「歼击者锯刃」才能打开

block.eeeabsmobs.sliding_door_level2.tip.en: This door requires a Guardian Core or Doombolt Battleaxe to open
block.eeeabsmobs.sliding_door_level2.tip.zh: 这扇门需要「戍卫核心」或「谴雷战斧」才能打开

tip.eeeabsmobs.relic_annihilator_weak_po.en: Use a projectile attack on the head's exposed core to incapacitate it and reduce its attack accuracy
tip.eeeabsmobs.relic_annihilator_weak_po.zh: 使用弹射物攻击头部暴露的核心可使其瘫痪，并持续削弱其后续攻击精准度

tip.eeeabsmobs.realm_warden.en: Large AOE incoming! Escape the center!
tip.eeeabsmobs.realm_warden.zh: 将释放大范围攻击，快远离中心！

tip.eeeabsmobs.relic_earthshaker.en: Electrified targets take extra explosive damage from fire
tip.eeeabsmobs.relic_earthshaker.zh: 当目标身上带电且受到火焰攻击时，会额外受到爆炸伤害

tip.eeeabsmobs.relic_observer.en: Electrified targets take extra explosive damage from fire
tip.eeeabsmobs.relic_observer.zh: 当目标身上带电且受到火焰攻击时，会额外受到爆炸伤害

jei.eeeabsmobs.eye_of_structure.tip.en: It will guide you to the corresponding structure just like an Ender Eye does.
jei.eeeabsmobs.eye_of_structure.tip.zh: 可像末影之眼一样引导你前往对应的结构。

effect.eeeabsmobs.erode_effect.descripti.en: The critical hit chance received increases with level, and each level additionally reduces the healing amount by 10%.
effect.eeeabsmobs.erode_effect.descripti.zh: 自身受到的暴击概率随等级提高而增加，并且每级额外降低10%回血量。

effect.eeeabsmobs.armor_lower_effect.des.en: Each level provides an additional 20% reduction in armor and armor toughness.
effect.eeeabsmobs.armor_lower_effect.des.zh: 每一级都额外降低20%的护甲值与盔甲韧性。

effect.eeeabsmobs.stun_effect.descriptio.en: During stun, you are unable to use items or place blocks, attack mobs or break blocks.
effect.eeeabsmobs.stun_effect.descriptio.zh: 眩晕期间无法移动，放置方块与破坏方块，攻击生物与交互事物。

effect.eeeabsmobs.frenzy_effect.descript.en: Obtain a boost in base attributes. In water, you will not take suffocation damage. Side effect: After the effect ends, you will be weakened.
effect.eeeabsmobs.frenzy_effect.descript.zh: 获得基础属性提升，在水中则不会受到窒息伤害。副作用：在效果结束后陷入虚弱。

effect.eeeabsmobs.electrified_effect.des.en: When the character takes Fire-type damage, it triggers an Overloaded reaction, dealing explosive damage while removing this effect.
effect.eeeabsmobs.electrified_effect.des.zh: 自身受到火类型伤害触发超载反应，造成爆炸伤害的同时清除该效果。
